title: Evidence on COVID-19 Mortality and Disparities Using a Novel Measure, COVID excess mortality percentage: Evidence from Indiana, Wisconsin, and Illinois
Public Pressure and Heterogeneous Effects of Voluntary Pollution Abatement
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We focus on the role of public pressure in environmental policy and describe a framework under which it is key to the success of voluntary pollution abatement. We hypothesize that a voluntary pollution abatement program changes the public pressure received by firms albeit differently for participants and nonparticipants. We describe these changes as well as the firm’s emission choices. We argue that, under our assumptions, the effectiveness of a voluntary pollution abatement program in lowering emissions depends on the cost from public scrutiny of participating firms and the associated risk of being labeled greenwashers: greater public scrutiny yields fewer program participants who free-ride on the reputation of the program, thereby increasing its effectiveness in lowering emissions. Our framework provides a narrative for reconciling the mixed empirical results on the effectiveness of voluntary pollution abatement programs and is supported by data from the EPA’s 33/50 program.
abstract_zh: 我们关注公众压力在环境政策中的作用，并构建了一个框架，在该框架下公众压力是自愿减排成功的关键。我们假设，自愿减排计划会以不同方式改变参与企业与非参与企业所承受的公众压力。我们描述了这些变化以及企业的排放选择。我们认为，在我们的假设下，自愿减排计划降低排放的有效性，取决于参与企业受到公众审视的成本，以及被贴上“漂绿”（greenwashers）标签的相关风险：更强的公众审视会减少借助该计划声誉而搭便车的参与者，从而提高其降低排放的有效性。我们的框架为调和自愿减排计划有效性的混合实证结果提供了一种解释，并得到美国环保署“33/50计划”数据的支持。

title: Behind Environmental Injustice: Disparate Siting Industries and Post-siting Demographic Transformation
Strategic Local Regulators and the Efficacy of Uniform Pollution Standards
abstract: We develop a framework outlining the incentives underlying the allocation of local pollution regulation resources under a uniform pollution standard. We find that a more stringent standard does not unambiguously lower pollution. In a jurisdiction where the local regulator faces a relatively high marginal benefit from allowing more local emissions (through a saving in regulatory resources) and a relatively low marginal cost (through an increased potential violation penalty), it is strategic to be non-compliant.  Under the assumption that the probability of being caught in violation increases at a decreasing rate with the extent of violation (or the gap between emissions and the uniform standard), we show that a tightening of the standard implies a lower marginal cost of allowing more local emissions, and the local regulator responds by reducing the resources allocated to regulating pollution. The net result is that local pollution rises when the pollution standard becomes more stringent. Our empirical analysis of the 2006 revision of the 24-hour PM2.5 National Ambient Air Quality Standard in the U.S. supports this framework, showing that both monitor readings and individual plant emissions increased in areas that had a very low probability of compliance and that intentionally violated the revised standard.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个框架，阐明在统一污染标准下，地方污染监管资源分配背后的激励机制。我们发现，更严格的标准并不必然降低污染。在地方监管者面临较高的允许更多地方排放的边际收益（通过节省监管资源实现）和较低的边际成本（通过提高潜在违规罚款实现）的辖区，不合规是一种策略性选择。假设被发现违规的概率随违规程度（或排放与统一标准之间的差距）的增加而以递减速率上升，我们证明，收紧标准意味着允许更多地方排放的边际成本降低，地方监管者会相应减少用于监管污染的资源。最终结果是，污染标准越严格，地方污染反而越高。我们对美国2006年修订的24小时PM2.5国家环境空气质量标准进行的实证分析支持了这一框架：在合规可能性极低并故意违反修订标准的地区，监测读数和单个工厂的排放均有所上升。

title: Air Quality Impacts of Shale Gas Development in Pennsylvania
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We estimate the impact of shale gas development on particulate matter pollution using a quasi-experimental setting in Pennsylvania where some wells were developed to produce natural gas whereas other wells were permitted but not drilled. In doing so, we utilize a novel empirical approach drawing upon insights from atmospheric chemistry to account for windblown pollution spillovers in a difference-in-differences framework. Utilizing a high frequency, high resolution satellite-based measure of PM pollution between 2000 and 2018, we identify causal increases in PM2.5 concentration ranging from 0.017 μg/m3 to 0.062 μg/m3 in the vicinity of over 20,000 wells, resulting in approximately 20 additional deaths between 2010 and 2017.
abstract_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州页岩气开发对空气质量的影响。我们利用宾夕法尼亚州的一个准实验情境来估计页岩气开发对颗粒物污染的影响，在该情境中，部分井已投入开采天然气，而另一些已获许可但未钻探的井则作为对照。在此过程中，我们采用了一种新颖的实证方法，借鉴大气化学的见解，在双重差分框架下考虑风吹污染的溢出效应。利用2000至2018年高频率、高分辨率的卫星颗粒物污染测量数据，我们识别出在20,000余口井附近PM2.5浓度的因果性上升，幅度为0.017 μg/m3至0.062 μg/m3，这导致2010至2017年间约增加20例死亡。
